name: Gyeongbokgung Palace
desc: A whole royal palace for the price of a coffee. Rent a hanbok and they wave you in for free.

name: Bukchon Hanok Village
desc: Tiled-roof lanes where old Seoul still lives. Whisper-quiet, camera-ready, completely free.

name: Gwangjang Market
desc: Bindaetteok sizzling since 1905. Squeeze onto a stool, point at things, live your street-food dream.

name: N Seoul Tower
desc: The love-lock tower on the mountain. Hike up free, pay only if you want the observatory glow-up.

name: Banpo Hangang Park
desc: Riverside picnic culture at its peak: delivery chicken, convenience-store ramyeon, rainbow bridge fountain.

name: Myeongdong Shopping Street
desc: Neon canyon of skincare, snacks, and street grills. Browsing costs nothing; willpower costs everything.

name: Changdeokgung Secret Garden
desc: A hidden royal garden behind a palace, tour-only and worth every won. Autumn here is a personality reset.

name: Seoul Sky at Lotte World Tower
desc: Glass floor on the 118th floor of Korea's tallest building. Save it for the day you feel invincible.

name: Hongdae Street
desc: Buskers, dance crews, and midnight energy that never asks for a cover charge. Seoul's free main stage.

name: Namsan Park Trails
desc: A mountain in the middle of the city, stairs and all. Sunrise up top costs nothing but your sleep schedule.
